description: This file defines API routes related to user authentication, including login for access tokens and user registration, using FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, and custom authentication utilities.

classes.name: Token
classes.details: Represents the structure of the token returned after login.

classes.name: User
classes.details: Represents a user object returned after registration.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Model for new user registration data.

methods.name: login_for_access_token( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles login requests, verifies user credentials, and returns an access token.

methods.name: register_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles user registration, checks for existing email and username, and creates a new user.

ctags.name: login_for_access_token
ctags.signature: ( form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends(), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )

ctags.name: register_user
ctags.pattern: /^async def register_user(user: UserCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db)):$/
